full_prompt_en: The image is a square, finely modeled oil-painting close-up of an older man's gray beard, ornate gold-trimmed robe, and hand held near his chest. The tight crop removes his eyes and forehead, leaving the lower nose, closed mouth, and full beard at the center and upper left. Gray and cream hairs divide into many fine strands, darker at the outer curls and luminous through the broad middle of the beard. On the right, part of his jaw and neck turns toward a dark background with a pale carved column or frame behind it. A narrow strip of worn architectural carving appears at the far left edge, its muted gold lines echoing the clothing. Beneath the beard, a deep rust-brown inner garment rises to the neck with a narrow dark green edging. Over it, two large outer panels fall from the shoulders, heavy brown fabric covered with dense gold scrollwork, curling leaves, and raised ornamental borders. The left panel enters from the lower left, while the right panel runs diagonally down toward the lower center. Between them, the man's pale hand closes gently around a thin dark cord or edge of cloth at chest height. The hand's knuckles, nails, and soft creases are visible, though no object is clearly held beyond that narrow line. Warm light falls from the upper left front, catching the beard, fingers, and gold embroidery while the folds beneath the hand and the right background remain dark. The paint is smooth across skin but densely textured in hair and decorative stitching, with tiny dark lines giving each gold curl definition. The viewpoint is so close that the fabric and beard fill nearly every corner, making the cropped face and hand an intimate study of surface. The overall composition uses cream-gray, burnished gold, and dark rust against narrow shadowed edges, emphasizing intricate texture and quiet gravity.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、精细塑形的油画近景，描绘年长男子的灰须、金色绣饰长袍和一只抬在胸前的手。紧凑裁切去掉了他的眼睛与额头，只留下中央及左上方的鼻子下部、闭合的嘴和浓密胡须。灰色与奶油色须发分成许多细丝，外侧卷曲处更暗，宽大的胡须中部则发亮。右侧下颌和颈部转向深色背景，后面有一段浅色雕刻立柱或框架。最左画边露出一道磨旧的建筑雕刻，低饱和金色线条同衣服呼应。胡须下方，深锈棕色内衣升到颈边，带窄窄的深绿色滚边。外层两大块衣料从肩头垂下，厚重棕布上密布金色卷纹、弯曲叶形与凸起装饰边。左侧衣片从左下进入，右侧衣片斜斜落向下方中央。两片之间，一只浅色手在胸口轻轻握着细暗线或衣料边。手指关节、指甲与柔软褶纹可见，但除那条细线外，看不见明确握持的物件。暖光从左前上方照来，点亮胡须、手指与金绣，手下衣褶和右侧背景保持深暗。颜料在皮肤上平顺，在毛发与装饰绣线处则十分密集，细小暗线确定每一道金色卷纹。视点近到布面与胡须几乎填满各角，使裁切的面孔和手成为亲近的表面研究。整体构图以奶油灰、磨亮金与深锈色对照狭窄暗边，强调精密纹理与安静厚重的气息。
style_prompt_en: Finely modeled oil paint sets smooth warm midtones beside densely worked fibrous and ornamental textures. Cream-gray highlights and burnished gold emerge from deep rust-brown, umber, and near-black, making a limited palette feel rich through value changes. Minute curved lines repeat inside larger diagonal bands, while broad shadowed folds prevent the fine detail from filling every area equally. Soft transitions round the light focal forms; decorative edges are sharper and more intricately traced. Warm upper-side light catches raised surfaces and leaves recessed spaces in deep colored shade. A very close crop makes texture, overlapping planes, and a small pale focal region carry the composition. The overall treatment is intimate, weighty, and meticulously tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 精细塑形的油彩把平顺的暖色中间调放在密密处理的纤维与装饰肌理旁。奶油灰高光和磨亮金色从深锈棕、棕褐与近黑中浮出，使有限配色凭明度变化仍显浓郁。细小弯线在较大斜向色带中重复，宽阔背阴褶面则避免细节均匀填满每处。柔软过渡使亮部焦点形体圆润，装饰性边缘更锐利、描画更繁密。暖色上侧光击中凸起表面，内凹空间留在深色的有色阴影中。极近裁切让纹理、交叠平面和一处小浅色焦点承担构图。整体处理亲近、厚重且触感描绘极细。
theme_en: A close view of an older man's gray beard, ornate gold-trimmed robe, and clasped hand
theme_zh: 近距离描绘年长男子的灰须、金色绣饰长袍与握起的手
name: Jan van Scorel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
